name: Cleopatra Hospitals Group S.A.E.
source: Cleopatra Hospital Group H1 2026 IR presentation (cleopatrahospitals.com), profit before tax 489.5m and net income tax charge 147.5m (current 160.0m less deferred credit 12.5m), which ties to reported profit after tax of 342m CRON 20261107: H1 2026 column completed from Cleopatra Hospitals Group interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (cleopatrahospitals.com/media/lu2hhgwg/chc-consolidated-fs-30-june-2026.pdf, profit or loss page 3, EGP): revenue 4,309,172,850; cost of revenue 2,842,493,175; gross profit 1,466,679,675; general and administrative expenses 828,100,000; provisions 21,000,000; other income 4,100,000; EBIT 621,700,000; interest income 16,300,000; interest expense 148,500,000; profit before tax 489,500,000; income tax 160,000,000 less deferred tax credit 12,500,000; profit after tax 342,038,711. Printed column ties: revenue less cost of revenue equals gross profit; gross profit less general and administrative expenses less provisions plus other income equals EBIT 621,700,000; EBIT less net finance cost 132,200,000 equals profit before tax 489,500,000. Operating Expenses carries the residual gross profit less EBIT, 844,979,675, the same construction the stored FY2025 column uses (2,858,469,872 less 1,272,520,736 equals 1,585,949,136), so the rendered identity Gross Profit less Operating Expenses equals EBIT holds. Net Finance Costs is interest expense 148,500,000 less interest income 16,300,000. Revenue H1 2026 restated from the rounded 4,309,200,000 to the printed 4,309,172,850 so that the rendered identity Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit holds to the Egyptian pound against the printed cost of revenue.
